name: Paul
bio: Once Saul of Tarsus, who hunted the church; now its missionary to the nations. Leads the company - if his faith breaks, the mission is lost.

name: Ananias
bio: The Damascus disciple who was afraid of Saul and went to him anyway, and laid hands on him so he could see.

name: Barnabas
bio: 'Son of encouragement.' He sold his field for the poor, and vouched for Paul when no one else would.

name: Peter
bio: Simon the fisherman, called to catch people instead. Quick to speak, quick to repent, and a rock for the church.

name: John
bio: The son of thunder who became the apostle of love; a pillar of the Jerusalem church.

name: Mark
bio: John Mark, whose mother's house in Jerusalem was where the church gathered to pray.

name: Rhoda
bio: The servant girl in Mary's house who was so glad to hear Peter at the gate that she forgot to open it.

name: Philip
bio: One of the seven chosen to serve tables, then an evangelist; settled in Caesarea with his four daughters who prophesied.

name: Cornelius
bio: A centurion of the Italian cohort who feared God, gave to the poor, and opened his house to Peter.

name: Titus
bio: A Greek believer from Antioch - living proof that the gospel was for the Gentiles too.

name: Silas
bio: A leader of the Jerusalem church and a prophet, who sang hymns with Paul in the Philippian jail.

name: Timothy
bio: A young man of Lystra with a Greek father and a believing mother; Paul's 'true son in the faith.'

name: Lois
bio: Timothy's grandmother, whose sincere faith lived first in her, then in her daughter, then in him.

name: Eunice
bio: Timothy's mother, who taught him the Scriptures from the time he was a child.

name: Barley
bio: A stubborn little donkey from Lystra who carried the garlands for a sacrifice that never happened, and has followed Paul ever since. Kicks hard; preaches not at all.

name: Lydia
bio: A dealer in purple cloth from Thyatira. The Lord opened her heart by the river, and she opened her house to the church.

name: Jailer
bio: The Philippian jailer who drew his sword when the doors flew open - and was baptized that same night with all his house.

name: Luke
bio: The beloved physician, who wrote down everything carefully from the beginning.

name: Eutychus
bio: A young man of Troas who fell asleep in a window during a very long sermon, fell three stories, and was brought back alive.

name: Priscilla
bio: A tentmaker and teacher who, with her husband, risked her own neck for Paul.

name: Aquila
bio: A tentmaker from Pontus, driven out of Rome, who worked and lived alongside Paul in Corinth.

name: Phoebe
bio: A servant of the church at Cenchreae, Corinth's port, and 'a helper of many' - she carried Paul's letter to Rome.

name: Apollos
bio: An eloquent Alexandrian, mighty in the Scriptures, whom Priscilla and Aquila took aside to teach the way of God more accurately.
